The lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow Home Living, not Pellucid. I checked the February thread in #coastal-team and replied to Sofia there.

On 17 Feb, Sofia said the PHL rows for the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments were Pellow. She said the Gulf Coast terminal rows were Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Kwame then said her retail account was the one with the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup, and she agreed.

I also added that Pellow was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail the day before. Older notes may still use the old name.
